sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to [[Valley of the Kings, Egypt]] under [[Klaus]] to uncover the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]]. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his [[Sekhmet]] and then attacked [[Lok Lambert]] with [[Windrush]]. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. {{source|All Work and No Pay}}

Lok later distracted him and [[unnamed Suit 032]] with a puzzle that he claimed was found within the tomb while [[Zhalia Moon]] took a map from [[unnamed Suit 036]]. He and a team of Suits later caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, and he invoked Sekhmet. Dante's team, however, got away. Upon catching up to Dante's team at a pool, he again invoked Sekhmet to fight against [[Sabriel]] and [[Lindorm]].  {{source|The Sceptre Deception}}

full_text:
Unnamed Suit 031 is a Suit working with Klaus within in the Organization at the site of the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt.

== History ==
This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to Valley of the Kings, Egypt under Klaus to uncover the Tomb of Nefertiti. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his Sekhmet and then attacked Lok Lambert with Windrush. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. [All Work and No Pay]

Lok later distracted him and unnamed Suit 032 with a puzzle that he claimed was found within the tomb while Zhalia Moon took a map from unnamed Suit 036. He and a team of Suits later caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, and he invoked Sekhmet. Dante's team, however, got away. Upon catching up to Dante's team at a pool, he again invoked Sekhmet to fight against Sabriel and Lindorm. [The Sceptre Deception]

== Abilities ==
This Suit and his team were given desert-based Titans by the Organization.

===Spells Utilized===
* Windrush

===Bonded Titans===
* Sekhmet

== Trivia ==

* Yuri Lowenthal Who Voices Lok voiced the Unamed Suit in Huntik
